title: Pro Tip: Strategic Cleanout Placement for Long-Term Maintenance
description: Installing drain lines requires planning for future maintenance access. A cleanout provides direct access to clear obstructions without dismantling fixture traps or breaching walls. Best practices include installing accessible cleanouts at directional changes greater than 45 degrees, at the base of vertical stacks, and near the building exit point. Always ensure adequate clearance around cleanouts so drain cleaning equipment can be operated smoothly and safely.
